title: Documentation
intro: Step-by-step guides covering installation, the Community hub, templates & sharing, anti-grief and the API.

getting_started.heading: 1. Getting started
getting_started.body: Pick a flavour: Tampermonkey userscript, Chrome MV3 unpacked, Firefox temporary add-on, or a Safari wrap (macOS + Xcode).
steps: Open the homepage and grab the download link for your browser.
Install per the instructions on the card.
Visit filianislost.com — the Win95 panel pops up in the top-right.
The first time you visit, the extension auto-attaches to our backend (no manual login needed).
getting_started.tip: Auto-update polls /dist/signature.json every 30 minutes. Tampermonkey can also auto-update userscripts natively.

community.heading: 2. Community & clans
community.body: Since v6 everything social lives in one Community super-tab (it replaced the old separate Social and Clan tabs):
items: My clan — roster with roles (owner / admin / mod / member), invites, applications, settings, clan avatar + banner.
Chats — global chat, clan chat, direct messages and modmail, with reactions, pinned messages and read-state.
Browse — the public clan directory: join open clans, apply, accept invites, or create your own. Clan creation is owner-verified — via a Discord guild you own, your site profile, or manual review.
Info — author & donate links, SnackersWiki and both Discord servers in one card.
community.tip: Mail and Achievements moved into the Profile tab in the same update.

templates.heading: 3. Templates & sharing
templates.body: Templates are the core content unit of the V3 API: a position (x/y), scale 5%–1000%, a multi-layer document and optional sprite-sheet animation.
items: Scopes: private (only you), clan (your clan-mates), public (everyone — goes through the moderation queue before appearing in the gallery).
Sharing: every template is linkable; an optional access password lets people outside the whitelist open it.
Previews: the server renders thumbnails (GET /api/v3/templates/{id}/preview?size=64|128|256), full PNGs and animated GIF exports — no client rendering needed.
Manage from the site: the Dashboard lists your templates and lets you rename, move, re-scale, change scope, set/remove the access password or delete them — without opening the extension.

anti_grief.heading: 4. Anti-grief monitoring
anti_grief.body: Protect a finished area: the backend re-fetches the matching window of wall tiles every check_interval seconds (60s…24h, default 120), diffs it against the reference snapshot, and alerts your clan (mailbox + Discord/Telegram) when damage crosses tolerance_pct.
anti_grief.disable: Manage regions with GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v2/regions/{id} (this guard still lives on the V2 surface). The region owner, clan moderators/admins and global staff can edit or remove a region.

linked_accounts.heading: 5. Linked accounts
methods: Telegram via OIDC (oauth.telegram.org) with PKCE + telegram:bot_access scope. Bot can DM you afterwards.
Discord via standard OAuth2 with identify scope. Bot can DM you if you share a guild with it or DM it first.
Email through support: request a 6-char code, email the support address with subject LINK-MAIL from your address, an admin approves.
linked_accounts.tip: VAI Account is a separate identity at /vai-auth — designed to span all VAI-PROG services. You can bind it to your Wall user from the extension's Settings.

api.heading: 6. API
api.body: Two surfaces live side by side under /api/:
surfaces: /api/v3/* — the current API: camelCase JSON, cursor pagination, public template browse, avatars with identicon fallback, clans, chats, achievements and the feed. New features land here.
/api/v2/* — deprecated, kept for older clients until sunset (the protected-region guard still lives here).
/api/v1/* equivalents and shared endpoints under /api/* — frozen, legacy clients.
api.browse: Browse interactively: Swagger UI · ReDoc. Raw spec: openapi.yaml.

troubleshooting.heading: 7. Troubleshooting
items: Panel doesn't appear: ensure you're on https://filianislost.com (not www.); reload after install.
Precise Place greyed out: Deep Integration is off, enable it in Settings and reload.
Deep Integration "WARN: missing probes": site bundle changed shape — wait for the next extension update or report at GitHub.
Still seeing separate Social / Clan tabs: update to v6+ — they merged into the Community super-tab.
CORS errors: clear cached service workers and reload. Production nginx now sets the headers explicitly.
"out of paint" toast: that's the site's cooldown — wait for refill or submit pending pixels.

self_host.heading: 8. Self-hosting the backend
self_host.body: Backend is a single Rust binary backed by Postgres + nginx + Let's Encrypt. See backend/Dockerfile and backend/example.env for the moving parts.
self_host.example:
cp backend/example.env backend/.env
docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d   # Postgres
cargo run --release                                  # backend
self_host.env_note: Or point THE_WALL_DEV_ENV_FILE at an external secrets file (overrides existing env vars).
